$comment: Preregistration of the one-tap test (/thesis Section VII). Committed before the test begins; the claim surface is NOT yet live and the test has NOT begun. The result — success, mixed, or failure — will be published on /thesis/ and in this file within 14 days of the final cohort day's day-90 mark. Field contract matches thesis-disclosure.json; 'preregistered' renders like a filled value with its committed date. The 2026-10-31 start was missed; see startMissed.

start.trigger: Public deployment of the one-tap claim surface on zodiacs.org, announced on /thesis/ when it happens

cohort: Visitors who complete the claim flow on the zodiacs.org claim surface during the 28-day window
uniqueClaimant: One wallet completing the claim flow for one chosen sign, counted once across all signs
exclusions: Wallets sharing a funding wallet with another claimant within 24 hours of the claim, and wallets created less than 24 hours before claiming with no other activity, are excluded as duplicates or bots

retention.numerator: Counted claimant wallets still holding at least the claimed amount of the claimed sign at claim + 90 days

dispersionMetric: Median per-sign top-10 token-account share, the instrument's published metric, snapshotted at start and at the final cohort day + 90

baseline.source: weekly distribution snapshots in the public repository

thresholds.success: ≥ 500 unique claimants AND ≥ 20% ninety-day retention AND median top-10 share falls ≥ 2.0 percentage points vs baseline
thresholds.failure: one or none of the three

publication: Within 14 days of the final cohort day's day-90 mark, on /thesis/ and in this file, regardless of outcome, including failure

startWindow.value: was due by 2026-10-31 · not started · redesign pending

verdictRule.value: success = all three · mixed = two · failure = one or none

uniqueClaimants.value: success ≥ 500 wallets · one claim per wallet · sybil exclusions preregistered

ninetyDayRetention.value: success ≥ 20% of claimants still holding the claimed amount at day 90

holderDispersion.value: success = median top-10 share falls ≥ 2.0pp vs the 2026-07-23 baseline (27.2%)

startMissed.note: The start date was missed. The claim surface was never built. The test is being redesigned. The thresholds are unchanged.
